summary: This Makefile target runs Docker Compose's config command to validate and display the final merged Docker Compose configuration. It uses a variable to specify which YAML files to include, allowing you to see what Docker will actually execute when you run your services.

explanations.1: PHONY tells Make that 'config' is a target name that doesn't correspond to an actual file on disk, so Make should always run it when you ask for it rather than checking if a file exists.
explanations.3: The ${DOCKER_YAML_FILES} is a variable substitution that gets replaced with the actual list of Docker Compose YAML files; this is passed as an environment variable to the docker compose config command, which outputs the final merged configuration after processing all those files.
